description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single ranged attacks (0.60 each), grants [ATK, DEF, MAG and RES +30% (25s)] to all allies, grants [Instant Cast 1]/[Instant Cast 1] and [Weakness +15% Boost (15s)]/[Instant Cast 1] and [Weakness +30% Boost (15s)] to the user/all allies/all allies if 1/2/4+ FF7 allies are alive, grants [Awoken Fire] and [Damage Cap +10000] to the user

description.name: Weakness +15% Boost (15s)
description.text: Increases damage dealt by 15% when exploiting elemental weaknesses

description.name: Weakness +30% Boost (15s)
description.text: Increases damage dealt by 30% when exploiting elemental weaknesses

description.name: Awoken Fire
description.text: Fire abilities don't consume uses and deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Fire abilities trigger 1 additional time
